rules.safety_requirement: must ensure id is a valid index into cf_info.frame_names before indexing
rules.applicable_condition: when cf_info.frame_names is indexed by id
rules.note: Indexing frame_names by node id without a shown bound check.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure gview_.node(id) returns a non-null NodeItem pointer before dereferencing item
rules.applicable_condition: when item is dereferenced after gview_.node(id)
rules.note: NodeItem pointer from graph view is used without a shown null check.

rules.safety_requirement: must check the Status returned by params_.create_kernel before using item->kernel
rules.applicable_condition: when params_.create_kernel is called and its Status is stored
rules.note: Kernel creation status is stored but no immediate check is shown in the cluster.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure const_tensor is non-null before dereferencing it in emplace_back
rules.applicable_condition: when const_tensor may be null and is dereferenced
rules.note: const_tensor is documented as possibly null and is dereferenced.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure id is a valid index into pending_ids_ before assignment
rules.applicable_condition: when pending_ids_ is indexed by id
rules.note: pending_ids_ is indexed by id; resize evidence is for enter_frame_info_, not pending_ids_.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure e->src_output() is less than n->num_outputs() before indexing outputs_required
rules.applicable_condition: when outputs_required is indexed by e->src_output() and e->src_output() >= 0
rules.note: outputs_required has length n->num_outputs(); index e->src_output() is only checked for non-negativity.
